summary: Local Activity execution causes nil pointer dereference panic in workflow task processing when using RoadRunner 2025.1.13. The underlying bug in RoadRunner's temporal plugin is fixed in v5.11.0.
userImpact: All workflows executing Local Activities crash when using RoadRunner 2025.1.13, making the feature completely unavailable.
rootCause: Bug in RoadRunner 2025.1.13's temporal plugin causing nil pointer dereference in workflow task processing.
proposedFix: Update to RoadRunner v5.11.0 or later, which includes the fix from roadrunner-temporal PR #761.
workaround: Downgrade RoadRunner to version 2025.1.12 or earlier until the fix is available.
keyQuote: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference
